subject: Penetration test disclosure — redaction, secure viewing, and NDA options for Finova
messages:
From: Michael Turner <michael.turner@finova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for pen test report (full) and remediation status

Hi Karthik,

Thank you for the quick call this morning. Procurement & our InfoSec team have asked for the most recent penetration test report and a current remediation status for any findings marked P0/P1.

Our compliance reviewers will accept a redacted version only if the redaction preserves CVE identifiers and the write-ups include remediation timelines. If those are redacted we will need an unredacted report under a vendor NDA and secure viewing conditions. Can you confirm what options Redwood supports (redacted PDF, secure portal viewing, in-person review, or escrow)? Also please include the SOC 2 evidence pointer or SIG/CAIQ where applicable.

We are trying to close the security gate for our pilot contract next week. Appreciate a short reply with options and an estimated timeline.

Thanks,
Michael Turner
Director, Vendor Security
Finova Bank
security@finova.com

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Turner <michael.turner@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report (full) and remediation status

Michael —

We can support a few approaches; I've outlined them below so you can pick what best fits Finova's procurement requirements: 

1) Executive summary + redacted report (fastest, usually 48 business hours): we provide a 2–4 page exec summary that includes severity counts, CVE references, and remediation statuses. The attached redacted PDF removes exploit PoC and internal hostnames but preserves CVE IDs and remediation timelines.

2) Secure, time-limited portal viewing (recommended for detailed review): we can grant named Finova security contacts a read-only view of the unredacted report inside our secure viewer (no download, watermarking, session recording). Typical viewing window is 72 hours after NDA execution.

3) On-site or dedicated shared environment review (for high-sensitivity customers): schedule an in-person review or a dedicated, ephemeral VM in a mutually agreed region; requires more lead time and an MSA amendment.

4) Escrow / third-party escrow: we can place the unredacted report in a neutral escrow (legal-approved) for conditional release under NDA/POC terms.

Marissa from our security team is included to propose a redaction matrix and confirm the default approach we use (we typically redact exploit scripts, internal IPs, and customer-only telemetry). If you opt for portal viewing, we can provide an evidence bundle and SOC2 pointer (link to evidence catalog) for cross-reference.

Estimated timelines: exec summary + redacted PDF: 48–72 hours after agreement on redaction scope; secure portal setup: 2–3 business days after NDA; escrow arrangement: 5–10 business days depending on legal review.

If you can share the exact names/emails of the two reviewers who will need portal access we can include them in the NDA and pre-provision the sessions.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales (Platform)
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Turner <michael.turner@finova.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report (full) and remediation status

Hi Michael — looping in our security/compliance lead (Laura). I wanted to add a bit more detail on what we propose for redactions and what we can include so your reviewers have meaningful context: 

- Redaction matrix: we typically classify findings P0/P1/P2 and only redact exploit PoC, privileged SSH keys, and internal flip addresses. We keep CVE identifiers, affected component, and remediation timeline.
- Exec summary: includes severity trend, top 5 actionable items, and a remediation status table (Fixed / In progress / Planned) with dates.
- Portal view: watermarking + forced MFA + session logs retained for 90 days.

If Finova requires CVE + remediation timeline as a hard requirement for acceptance, that aligns with our redacted output. For customers that require full proof-of-concept details, we require a signed NDA and provisioned portal access for named individuals; downloads are disabled.

I'll prepare a redaction_matrix.xlsx (sample) and send it over with a redacted PDF and exec summary if you confirm you want option (1) now.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
From: Michael Turner <michael.turner@finova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report (full) and remediation status

Thanks for the options — helpful. Procurement is comfortable accepting a redacted report only if the following are present: CVE identifiers, affected component, and a remediation timeline with owner. If those three items are present we can proceed.

If your redacted PDF does not include remediation timelines, we will require the unredacted report under an NDA + secure portal. We would prefer the portal (option 2) so our security team can see context without downloading. Please send the DocuSign NDA link and we will route for signature. Also confirm whether Redwood will grant 72-hour portal access to our CISO (ciso@finova.com) and one backup reviewer.

One additional ask: if critical P0/P1 issues are later discovered to be mischaracterized or require rework after delivery, are there any SLA credits or extensions to the pilot timeline we can negotiate? Procurement prefers clarity up-front.

Regards,
Michael

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Turner <michael.turner@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report (full) and remediation status

Michael — attached is the proposed package based on your requirements: 
- pen_test_exec_summary.pdf (2-page exec summary with remediation table)
- pen_test_report_v2_redacted.pdf (redaction retains CVE IDs, affected component, and remediation timelines; PoC and internal hostnames removed)
- redaction_matrix.xlsx (shows what fields were redacted and why)
- DocuSign NDA link (https://app.docusign.com/NDAs/REDWOOD-FINOVA-2025) — please have the named reviewers sign; we will pre-provision the portal once signature completes.

Portal access: we will grant ciso@finova.com and one backup reviewer a 72-hour, read-only session with watermarking and session logs. Access provisioning typically occurs within 24 hours of signed NDA.

SLA / pilot timeline: for a situation where high-severity items are re-opened due to missing remediation, we can offer a one-week pilot extension or a small credit against first month of usage. We can capture this in a short amendment to the SOW — I will copy our legal lead if you want to formalize now.

Please confirm who will sign the NDA (name + email) and whether you want the redacted package now while the NDA routes or prefer to wait until the NDA is executed.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales (Platform)
Redwood Inference

---
From: Michael Turner <michael.turner@finova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 16:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for pen test report (full) and remediation status

Karthik / Marissa —

We will sign the NDA. Signatories: Michael Turner (michael.turner@finova.com) and Sarah Patel, Senior Security Engineer (sarah.patel@finova.com). Once the NDA is signed we prefer the 72-hour portal access for the CISO and Sarah. If you can provide the redacted package in parallel to the NDA routing (so procurement can review while legal signs) that would be ideal — procurement has asked for the exec summary + remediation table today.

For SLA/credits: the one-week extension sounds reasonable as long as it is documented in the SOW amendment; procurement will follow up separately. We are requesting that the remediation status table explicitly show status (Fixed / In progress / Planned) and last-updated date for each P0/P1 item. We'll schedule a 30-min follow-up call next week after review.

Thanks — we appreciate the speed.

-Michael
Director, Vendor Security
Finova Bank
